verses.english: “There are, mendicants, these two kinds of happiness.
Happiness with pleasure and happiness with equanimity.
These are the two kinds of happiness.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imesaṁ dvinnaṁ sukhānaṁ yadidaṁ upekkhāsukhan”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of happiness is happiness with equanimity.”
